name: fileName
label: File name
help: Name of the file, with its extension. For example, `book.epub`.

name: data
label: Data
help: Content of the EPUB e-book to convert, without DRM and up to 1,500 pages. The PDF uses standard fonts instead of the book's own. Books made of full-page images, such as comics and picture books, are refused when their pages would come out blank.
